emotionAi.title: How Does AI Feedback Work?
emotionAi.subtitle: There are 7 emotions detected by AI: Neutral, Sad, Happy, Surprised, Scared, Bored, and Angry. The AI system provides feedback every 3–5 minutes.
emotionAi.intervalInfo: AI analyzes facial patterns & provides feedback every 3–5 minutes (or upon significant emotional shifts).
emotionAi.citationDesc: GetSmart's emotional analysis and adaptive affective intervention concepts are grounded in cognitive psychology and facial expression research (Ekman, 2004; Goetz et al., 2023).

sad.label: Sad
sad.pattern: Drawn mouth corners, slow response rate
sad.feedback: Don't give up! I know you can do this!

happy.label: Happy
happy.pattern: Smiling, bright eyes on correct answers
happy.feedback: I'm glad to see you happy!

surprised.label: Surprised
surprised.pattern: Widened eyes discovering a new concept

scared.label: Scared
scared.feedback: I know you can do it! Don't be afraid!

bored.label: Bored
bored.feedback: Hang in there! You'll find something exciting soon!

angry.label: Angry
angry.feedback: Be patient! You will get through this smoothly!

diagnosticSection.feature1Desc: Detects 7 real-time facial expressions during diagnostic test completion.
diagnosticSection.feature2Desc: Measures foundational mastery with structured countdown timers.
diagnosticSection.feature3Desc: Analyzes specific sub-competencies mastered vs areas needing improvement.
diagnosticSection.feature4Desc: Automatically routes students to video-assisted remedial content if passing threshold is not met.

faq.title: Understanding GetSmart Methodology
faq.subtitle: An interactive guide to the three core pillars of GetSmart's adaptive learning.
faq.q1Desc: An initial assessment designed to analyze student understanding of foundational Science, Math, and Logic concepts before starting new learning paths.
faq.q1Output: Weakness mapping and personalized Learning Path recommendations.
faq.q2Desc: Students who haven't passed the diagnostic test receive interactive discussion videos per incorrect question, accompanied by real-time AI emotion detection, before taking a new variant remedial quiz.
faq.q2Ai: If AI detects frustration or boredom, the system offers verbal/textual encouragement and simplifies concept explanations.
faq.q3Title: How to Use Learning Modules & E-Worksheets?
faq.q3Desc: Students learn through PDF Flipbooks, watch YouTube starter videos, and complete E-Worksheets (Google Forms) with progress automatically tracked at every step in the system.

remedialSection.aiFeedbackDesc: When student shows frustration or boredom, AI automatically offers encouragement:
remedialSection.aiFeedbackQuote: "Don't give up! I know you can do this!"
remedialSection.phase1Desc: Student does not pass diagnostic quiz (score below KKM). System automatically unlocks remedial path.
remedialSection.phase2Desc: Discussion video is shown for each incorrect question. Student must watch completely before continuing.
remedialSection.phase3Desc: AI detects 7 facial emotions in real-time: Neutral, Sad, Happy, Surprised, Fearful, Bored, Angry. If frustration is detected, AI provides encouragement.
remedialSection.phase4Desc: Student takes a new variant remedial quiz. Score and pass/fail status are displayed immediately.

eworksheetSection.description: Each learning topic consists of three integrated core components: PDF flipbook material, YouTube starter videos, and interactive E-Worksheets. Student progress is automatically tracked at every step.
eworksheetSection.trackingBoxDesc: The system records every material read, video watched, and E-Worksheet completed. Teachers and parents can monitor all progress via the LAD Dashboard.
eworksheetSection.pdfDesc: Materials presented in interactive PDF flipbook format readable directly in browser. Completed status is automatically recorded.
eworksheetSection.pdfFeature1: Embedded PDF reader directly on page
eworksheetSection.videoDesc: Starter videos from YouTube displayed directly with full controls. Auto-records progress upon watch completion.
eworksheetSection.elkpdDesc: E-Worksheets embedded directly from Google Forms/Docs. Students complete interactive exercises without leaving platform.

roles.parentDesc: Receive learning progress updates, test mastery reports, and character growth insights directly on your mobile device.
